files.docs/README.md:
# Docs

The new Linux-hosted site serves lowercase extensions only.
docs/legacy/ is mirrored by an FTP job that matches on the exact upper-case names, so never rename anything in there.
*.sig files are detached signatures and keep their names.

turns.prompt: Change the .TXT extension to .txt on every document under docs, subfolders included. docs/README.md says which files must keep their names. Check the result and reply DONE.
